title: Nafta Feejignaanta leh ee ku taal Webiga Daanta
intro: Naf yar ayaa loo xilsaaray hawlgal qarsoodi ah, si uu meel fog uga daawado marka qaddarku ka soo muuqdo biyaha dushooda. Iyada oo aan la arkin oo aan la tuhunsanayn, qofkani wuxuu door muhiim ah ka ciyaari doonaa beddelidda taariikhda qaran.
clues: Hooyaday waxaa i siisay shaqo, mid u baahan qarsoodi iyo feejignaan.
Indhahaygu waxay raaceen sariir yar oo ku dul wareegaysa hirarka, qalbigayguna uu walwalsan yahay.
Markii ay heleen dad aan la filayn, waan soo dhawaaday, anigoo cabsi ka buuxdo.
Waxaan arkay quustooda ay u qabaan daryeele, waxaana u soo bandhigay xal anigoo aan runta sheegin.
Faragelintii aan ku sameeyay waqtigii loogu talagalay waxay dib ugu soo celisay naf naas nuujinaysa tii ugu baahida badnayd.
Maxkamadaha awoodda badan, waxaan ku hadlay: 'Ma idiin tilmaami doonaa qoys quudin doona oo si taxaddar leh u daryeeli doona?'

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Waxay dib ula midowday cunuggii hooyadiis
outcome.answer: Waxay dib ula midowday cunuggii hooyadiis

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
